clue.text: Strange men in Asia cannot recall being there

definitions.note: a description of the state rather than a noun; the condition of someone who cannot remember

indicators.note: strange suggests something out of order, so these letters are jumbled into a new word

explanation.surface: Travellers in Asia have no memory of having been there.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strange' rearranges MEN and ASIA together; 'in' simply joins them.
explanation.definitionFit: Loss of memory is the medical condition in which a person cannot remember past events.

clue.text: Religious retreats by the tree and sheep

parts.note: the ash is a common tree
rams are male sheep

explanation.surface: Monastic hideaways set among trees with grazing flocks.
explanation.definitionFit: Hermitages in India where people gather for spiritual instruction are religious retreats.

clue.text: Close to the beginning of time?

definitions.text: Close to the beginning of time?

parts.note: nigh is an old word meaning near

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter, here taken from time

explanation.surface: A question about what lay nearest the start of the universe.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is also the definition: darkness was there near the start of creation, and each day's darkness is time near its close.
explanation.definitionFit: Darkness preceded light in the Genesis account, so the dark hours sit close to the start of time.

clue.text: Needle worker from the gutter

explanation.surface: A seamstress who has risen from a humble background.
explanation.definitionFit: A seamstress stitches with a needle; a drain or gutter carries waste water underground.

clue.text: One like Picasso faces Einstein the performer

parts.note: Picasso was a painter, an example of an artist

indicators.note: the face of a word is its front, so its first letter is taken from Einstein

explanation.surface: A famous painter meets a famous physicist on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: An entertainer such as a singer or dancer is called a stage performer.

clue.text: Gossip feature of comedian

parts.note: the chin is a facial feature
a wag is a joker or comedian

explanation.surface: Idle talk is a trademark of a stand-up comic.
explanation.walkthrough: CHINWAG is British slang for a chat.
explanation.definitionFit: A chat or natter, informal talk, is gossip.

clue.text: Motor account as in capital of Venezuela

parts.note: motor is an informal word for a car
taken as written

explanation.surface: A car's records are kept in the country's capital.
explanation.definitionFit: The chief city and seat of government of Venezuela.

clue.text: Is to make better about having to ad-lib

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for making better goes round the word is

parts.note: to improve is to make better
taken as written

explanation.surface: Bettering something involves making it up as you go.
explanation.definitionFit: To speak or perform without preparation is to extemporise.

clue.text: Position accompanied by what?

parts.note: where asks about position or place
with means accompanied by

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about where one stands and who comes along.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is also the definition: an old word meaning 'with which', i.e. accompanied by what.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic relative adverb meaning by means of which or with which.

clue.text: A sheep turns up missing so hop it

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up reads the word for sheep from bottom to top

parts.note: a teg is a sheep in its second year
something missing is lost

explanation.surface: A sheep comes back after going astray, so it is told to clear off.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are rude commands telling someone to go away.

clue.text: Tide before the turn in the tarn

definitions.text: Tide before the turn in the tarn

parts.words: Tide before the turn in the tarn
parts.note: a cryptic description of the top of the tide, just before it starts to fall, with the tarn suggesting a flood of water

explanation.surface: Watching the water level peak in a mountain lake.
explanation.definitionFit: The highest level reached by a tide, just before it ebbs.

clue.text: Entreaty at last will fold

parts.note: a plea is an entreaty

indicators.note: at last points to the final letter of the word at

explanation.surface: A final appeal will cause someone to give in.
explanation.definitionFit: A pressed crease in cloth is a fold.

clue.text: Dresses up the army and flags

indicators.note: in this clue up means the army's letters are turned round

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve
to flag is to tire

explanation.surface: Soldiers get dressed up while banners fly.
explanation.definitionFit: To attire is to clothe or dress someone.

clue.text: Near enough a cupboard with nothing

parts.note: a closet is a cupboard
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: An almost empty cupboard.
explanation.definitionFit: Nearly or approximately is the sense of the phrase.

clue.text: They have naked ambition to be in flight

definitions.text: They have naked ambition to be in flight

parts.words: They have naked ambition to be in flight
parts.note: plays on naked ambition literally: people who want to run nude, fleeing across a pitch

explanation.surface: Ruthless careerists keen to get away.
explanation.definitionFit: People who dash naked through a public place, often a sports ground.

clue.text: Russia ends with mountain — are in the country?

indicators.note: in places the mountain and are inside the ends of Russia
the ends of a word are its first and last letters, here those of Russia

parts.note: the Urals are a mountain range, so a Ural is a mountain
taken as written

explanation.surface: A question about whether Russian mountains count as countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: The countryside, as opposed to the town, is a non-urban district.

clue.text: Equivocation sees a big turn in friendship

indicators.note: in puts the big turn inside the word for friendship

parts.note: amity is friendship
taken as written
a U is a turn, as in a U-turn

explanation.surface: Ambivalence marks a sudden reversal in a relationship.
explanation.definitionFit: Being open to more than one interpretation is the essence of evasive vagueness.

clue.text: It has five hundred and ten you fool

indicators.note: has means contains, so the word it holds the number letters

parts.note: taken as written
D is the Roman numeral for 500
IO looks like 10, ten

explanation.surface: A mocking remark that only a fool would count so badly.
explanation.definitionFit: A stupid person is a fool.

clue.text: Scour the dense vegetation

explanation.surface: Cleaning up the overgrown bush.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrub is to clean hard by rubbing; scrubland is low, dense bushy growth.

clue.text: Has discovered that rats chewed Hindu holy writing

indicators.note: chewed means mangled, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Rodents have gnawed a sacred text.
explanation.definitionFit: A Sanskrit treatise or sacred text in Hinduism.

clue.text: Latitudes fashionable for intergalactic travel

parts.note: latitudes means room to move, spaces
hip means fashionable

explanation.surface: Trendy freedoms suitable for travelling between galaxies.
explanation.definitionFit: A vehicle designed to carry people beyond Earth through outer space.

clue.text: Step with or in saving

indicators.note: in places or inside the word for step

parts.note: a stage is a step in a process
taken as written

explanation.surface: Taking steps, or else putting money by.
explanation.definitionFit: Keeping things for later use is storage.

clue.text: At first nails then batters

indicators.note: first places the word at at the front, before the nails

parts.note: tacks are small nails

explanation.surface: A builder hammers in nails and then pounds away.
explanation.definitionFit: Assaults or onslaughts are what a batterer delivers.

clue.text: A case that is evident with one

indicators.note: with here means holding one inside

parts.note: patent means obvious or evident
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An obvious lawsuit involving one person.
explanation.definitionFit: A doctor speaks of a person under treatment as a case.

clue.text: Brisk legal or otherwise

indicators.note: otherwise means in another form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Something either lawful or quick.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical direction meaning fast and lively.

clue.text: It will pull a goat but only when upset

indicators.note: upset means overturned, so these letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Something will drag an animal along, but only if the goat is distressed.
explanation.definitionFit: A small powerful boat that tows ships pulls them.

clue.text: Bark may swell by end of April

parts.note: to grow is to swell

indicators.note: end of picks the last letter of April

explanation.surface: Tree bark may expand by late April.
explanation.definitionFit: A low threatening sound like a dog's bark.

clue.text: Imagine one ends with a secret number

indicators.note: with here means the ends hold the secret number between them
the ends of one are its first and last letters

parts.note: a PIN is a personal identification number, kept secret

explanation.surface: Someone pictures a single code they must keep quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: To give a view or suppose something is to think or imagine.

clue.text: I went after sailors' bones

indicators.note: went after means followed, so the I comes behind the sailors

parts.note: tars are sailors

explanation.surface: A person pursued some sailors' skeletons.
explanation.definitionFit: The small bones of the ankle and foot in plural.

clue.text: Cornerstone, it is a point made by a hermit

parts.note: an anchor is a mainstay or cornerstone
taken as written
E, east, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A recluse lays the foundation of something with a pointed remark.
explanation.definitionFit: A religious recluse who withdraws from society is a hermit.

clue.text: Examine any ales being brewed

indicators.note: brewing mixes ingredients, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Inspecting beers while they ferment.
explanation.definitionFit: To study in detail is to examine.

clue.text: Financially sound solution

explanation.surface: A sound financial fix.
explanation.definitionFit: Able to pay one's debts; a liquid able to dissolve other substances.
